budget.accounting_note: Cumulative over every per-meeting receipt of the G1 VAD supplement (pass A + pass B). Each pass ran as one run_precomp.py --turn-sources vad --ceilings-profile g1-supplement invocation whose PrecompBudget was pre-charged natively from the receipts already on disk (PrecompBudget.precharge / load_wave_receipts), so the registered supplement ceilings were enforced fail-closed across both passes in-process. This file re-emits the summary over all receipts because build_wave_summary sees only the outcomes of the process that wrote it. Diar usage is 0 by construction: --turn-sources vad never contacts the pinned diar tool.
